result:
Tracked files are clean against `HEAD` (0ab3dd4).

What I did:
- `git restore --worktree --source=HEAD -- :/` reverted the three modified files (`README.md`, `python-flask/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`, `python-flask/.devcontainer/on-create-command.sh` — 6 added lines total, now discarded).
- `README.md` still showed as ` M` afterward even though `git diff` was empty. Cause: `core.autocrlf=true`, and the file is nothing but blank lines, so the restored worktree copy is 6 bytes (`\r\n\r\n\r\n`) against a 3-byte LF blob — content-identical after conversion, but the index stat entry was stale and `git update-index --really-refresh` wouldn't clear it. Re-checking out that one file resolved it.

Untracked `ClaudeFlash/` was left untouched, and nothing was stashed or committed.
